items.summary: How I keep up to 800 enemies at 60 fps in #GodotEngine: 1. No physics for most searches. Projectiles home in by distance, splash damage asks a spatial grid that is rebuilt once per physics frame. 2. No _draw() on anything that exists in the hundreds. Auras are a shader on a quad, the enemy passes its state as an instance uniform. 3. Path tables instead of sampling a Curve2D per enemy and frame. 4.
